meta: One modular Purified Water package: PVC pretreatment, polypropylene RO, DI or EDI and distribution, to USP <645> 1.3 µS/cm and USP <643> 500 ppb TOC. Every skid wet tested at FAT.
headline: Built to the limit your auditor cites
lead: One modular package makes Purified Water (PW): pretreatment, RO, DI or EDI, distribution and controls. Start from your standard or your water grade.

stages.d: Chlorinated city or well water that changes with the season.

items.q: Can you supply one part, or should one supplier design it all?
items.a: We supply one modular package, designed together: pretreatment, RO, DI or EDI and distribution. [Whether single modules are supplied alone]. Interface limits go in the functional specification; we test our side at FAT.

items.q: Where does your scope end and our plant begin?
items.a: At battery limits stated connection by connection in the proposal: [standard battery limits, typical scope]. Anything outside is listed with who supplies it.

items.q: How do we size generation against storage?
items.a: From your point-of-use demand over a full production day. Generation covers average draw plus sanitization and recovery; the tank covers the peaks. We share the calculation.

items.q: Do you build to standard platforms or to order?
items.a: [standard platforms, capacity ranges, lead time in weeks]. Either way, materials, instruments and controls are adapted to your URS.

items.q: Can your PW feed the WFI still we run?
items.a: Yes. PW is the usual feed to a WFI still. You run the still; we size PW to its feed limits and peak draw and state the interface in the functional specification.
